reason: 该插件的主要用途是求职流程数据化处理：其 README 明确说明可导入岗位与简历、标准化去重匹配并生成报告和可本地打开的静态页面，同时可通过配置好的白名单站点调用外部 BrowserSkill 读取招聘信息，因此属于面向求职情报与数据处理的插件。由于会处理个人简历/岗位画像并访问外部招聘站点，风险评估为中等（R1）。

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向求职者的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，支持整理本地岗位与求职画像数据、解析简历、生成匹配分析与静态站点，并可在白名单招聘站点上执行只读岗位采集。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for job-hunting workflows that organizes local job and profile data, parses resumes, generates matching reports and static pages, and can run read-only job collection on configured whitelisted recruitment sites.

capabilities: Stores and updates job-related data (positions, profiles, interests, reports) in the active workspace.
Parses local resume and posting files (DOCX, text-based PDF, TXT, Markdown) using local processing dependencies.
Collects structured job data from whitelisted recruitment domains via BrowserSkill in read-only mode.

reasons.code: Plugin purpose and behavior are centered on local workspace-based job intelligence workflows (import, normalization, matching, reporting, and workspace outputs).
Resume parsing pipeline includes DOCX/PDF/TXT/Markdown support with explicit limits for scanned/encrypted PDFs and OCR not used.
Browser-based collection is restricted to configured allowed domains and requires confirmed flag, with per-run and interval controls.
Runtime exports and CLI/package metadata expose DSH plugin/skill entry points and dependencies for local resume parsing.
